description: Command-line tool of the Flutter Bond framework: creates projects from the flutter-bond template, generates models, widgets and service providers, and runs `bond mcp`, an MCP server that explains the bond_* packages to coding agents.
rules: Install with dart pub global activate bond_cli (requires Dart 3.13 or newer).
bond create project --projectName <name> --bundleId <ios.bundle.id> [--applicationId <android.id>] [--appName <name>] [--ref v2.1.0] [--template-url <git url or path>].

Generators: bond create model --name UserDetail --feature profile; bond create widget --name ProfileCard --type consumer --feature profile; bond create service_provider --name Profile --feature profile. Files go to lib/features/<feature>/.
bond mcp starts an MCP server (stdio) with the tools packages, package_overview, api, migration, create_model, create_widget, create_service_provider and create_project.
Install bond_cli with dart install bond_cli, then add {"command": "bond", "args": ["mcp"]} to the project's .mcp.json.

bond upgrade [--to v2.2.0] [--dry-run] brings a project's template files (iOS/Android config, scripts) up to a newer flutter-bond version on a new git branch. Projects without bond.yaml pass --from <version>.
